Hi all — thanks Naomi and Lara for surfacing this.

Clarification from the audit team:

- The reissue we published on 2026-03-11 corrected a cover-page metadata field that had an incorrect "effective date" stamp. The underlying audit period remained unchanged: the report covers the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 and the attestation scope is identical.
- The "authoritative" field for procurement is the audit period on the cover and the attestation language in Section 1. We will provide a signed reissue letter that states this explicitly.
- We currently have a draft bridge letter that confirms continuity of controls from the end of the audit period to present; it's attached as "SOC2_Bridge_Letter_DRAFT_2026-06-26.pdf". We expect the final signed bridge to be available by 2026-06-30 pending legal review.

Action items we will deliver to Greenline:
1) Signed Reissue Letter (explaining the cover-page correction) — attached.
2) Final Bridge Letter (signed) — expected 2026-06-30.
3) A short one-page summary for procurement stating the report ID and explicit audit coverage (see below).

Report ID for reference: RWI-SOC2-T2-2025-06
Data residency note: the SOC 2 attestation covers controls relevant to data handling but does not certify specific regional residency. If you need documentation tied to EU data residency or specific hosting regions, we can provide our hosting map and privacy addendum.

Naomi/Connor — I'll upload the signed artifacts to the secure Drive and provide a DocuSign envelope for signature if procurement requires.

Thanks,
